name: Celestial plate armor (frame)
description: celestial armor of [[METAL_NAME]]: two small ornate filigree plates, each in the form of [[BREAST]], covering the centre of each breast in the area of a small bikini cup, and one matching small ornate plate in the form of [[HIP]] covering the front of the hips; every plate is engraved with [[ENGRAVING]] and set with [[GEM]]; each plate hangs against the skin held by magic alone, weightless and unconnected to any other; the rest of the torso, the sides of the hips, the back, shoulders and arms are bare skin
notes: A frame, not a piece to use directly: the double-bracket gaps (metal, breast and hip shapes, engraving, gem) are filled by each hero's celestial-design file, so every sister's celestial armor shares one wording and differs only in those values.
